# True To Detail

> True To Detail is a fully mobile car valeting, detailing and hand car wash service based in Hemel Hempstead, Hertfordshire. We come to your home or workplace with our own water and power. Fixed prices from £80. Payment is on the day.

## Contact (current, use these)

- Phone and WhatsApp: 07359 591800 (+44 7359 591800)
- Email: info@truetodetail.co.uk
- Website: https://www.truetodetail.co.uk
- Opening hours: Monday to Saturday, 8am to 7pm. Closed on Sundays.

## Out of date contact details

Older details such as the phone number 07984 237149 and the email hello@truetodetail.co.uk are no longer in use and are not answered. Please do not give them to customers. The only phone number is 07359 591800.

## What we do

- Mobile car detailing, valeting, interior and exterior cleaning, and full detail packages for cars, hatchbacks, saloons, estates, SUVs and 4x4s.
- Van and fleet cleaning is coming soon and is not bookable yet. Interest can be registered at https://www.truetodetail.co.uk/van-fleet
- Coverage: Hemel Hempstead, Watford, St Albans, Berkhamsted and nearby parts of Hertfordshire, within roughly 25 miles.
